title: Tour Lab Orders
summary: What the screen shows: pending orders, quick filters, an order’s details and the board.

steps.title: Menu → Clinic History → Lab Orders
steps.details: The jobs sent to external labs and the stage each one is in.

steps.title: List or board
steps.details: The list shows only pending orders. The board has one column per stage.

steps.title: Search
steps.details: Search by patient, job, lab or order number.

steps.title: Overdue only
steps.details: The number shows how many there are. An order is overdue when it goes past its stage’s days, or when the due date passes.

steps.title: Urgent
steps.details: Pending urgent orders. They also show first in the list.

steps.title: Due today
steps.details: What the labs have to deliver today. Useful for calling first thing in the morning.

steps.title: More filters
steps.details: Stage, lab, doctor, patient and dates. To also see finished orders, pick the All stage.

steps.title: An order
steps.details: Patient, lab, job and doctor. The Status column brings together the stage, the days in it and the due date. Anything overdue shows in red.

steps.title: One column per stage
steps.details: Drag a card to another column to change its stage.

steps.title: New order
steps.details: Registers a new job, which starts in the first stage.

steps.title: Set up
steps.details: To add labs, mark which services are lab jobs and adjust the stages.
